# D02 design: App shell, navigation and page templates

Covers AUTH05 (the org switcher in the shell), NFR23 (keyboard, focus, contrast, labels) and NFR24 (375, 768 and 1280 px) for every surface below.

Surfaces:

1. App shell: `(app)/layout.tsx` and `components/shell/AppShell.tsx`
2. Main nav: `components/shell/NavLinks.tsx`, built from `lib/nav.ts`
3. Org switcher: `components/shell/OrgSwitcher.tsx`
4. Account block and menu: `components/shell/AccountMenu.tsx`
5. Page templates: `components/templates/` (PageHeader, ListPage, DataTable, DetailPage, Workspace, DecisionFlow, DecisionChoice)
6. Shared states: `components/states/` (EmptyState, Skeleton presets, ErrorState, ForbiddenState) and their routes
7. Lab pages inside the shell: `(app)/lab/layout.tsx`, `(app)/lab/matches/page.tsx`
8. Placeholder pages: `/dashboard`, `/squad`, `/matches`, `/review`, `/shortlists`, and the `/settings` and `/admin` redirects
9. Template showcase: `/dev/templates/{list,detail,workspace,decision,states}`

## Rules for the whole chunk

- The D01 and C01 rules still apply:
  - Use tokens only, through `var(--token)` or the token-mapped Tailwind utilities (`bg-surface-sunken`, `text-ink-muted`, `border-line`).
  - Use Tailwind spacing steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 only (`space-1` to `space-12`).
  - Set text with the type classes only: `display-xl`, `heading-1`, `heading-2`, `body-lg`, `body`, `body-strong`, `label`, `caption`, `data` and `eyebrow`. Never set a font size with Tailwind or in CSS.
  - Icons are Lucide through `iconProps` (1.5 stroke, `aria-hidden`), 20px in the shell, and always sit next to a visible word. The one exception is an `IconButton`, which carries an `aria-label`.
  - The focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` rule: 2px solid `focus`, 2px offset. Never remove it. Where a parent draws the ring instead (DecisionChoice), use the PlayerCard `:has(:focus-visible)` pattern.
  - One primary button per view. A popover counts as part of its page.
- **Breakpoints.** The shell uses plain media queries in the Additions block: `(min-width: 992px)` for the sidebar, `(min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 991px)` for the rail, and `(max-width: 767px)` for phones. Tailwind's `md` (768) and `lg` (1024) stay as they are, so existing pages and the gallery baselines do not move.
- **Hidden variants.** Where the shell needs a different control per width (switcher trigger, account control), render both and hide one with `display: none`. That takes it out of the tab order and the accessibility tree. Give duplicated controls their own `useId()` ids.
- **Icons in nav.** Dashboard `LayoutDashboard`, Squad `Users`, Matches `Video`, Settings `Settings`, Review queue `ListChecks`, Shortlists `Bookmark`, Admin `Wrench`, Lab `FlaskConical`. Never use `star`, `shield-check`, `shield-off` or `flag` in the shell: the design system reserves them.
- **Theme.** The shell and every template follow the system setting. Two places are forced dark with `ThemeScope theme="dark"`: the Lab content area, and any `Workspace` with `theme="dark"` (C11's review workspace will use it). The sidebar, top bar and tab bar are never forced dark.
- **Shortcuts.** The shell adds no keyboard shortcuts. The review workspace shortcuts (J, K, Y, N, E) belong to C11.
- **Copy.** Sentence case, no exclamation marks, no emoji, British and South African spelling. "Your organisations" is the one name for `/organisations` everywhere (page title, switcher footer, account menu).
- **Placeholder copy** is draft. Mark it in code with `// Draft copy: replaced by <chunk>`.

### CSS: append to the "Additions (not in bundle.css)" block in `web/src/styles/components.css`

None of these components is in the design system. Each is specified here from existing tokens. Start the block with `/* App shell, popovers, templates and states for D02 (docs/build/design/D02.md). Not in the design system; built from tokens. Type comes from the type classes in the markup. */`

Dimension shorthands used below, all from tokens:

- Sidebar width: `calc(var(--space-12) * 5)` (240px).
- Rail width: `calc(var(--space-12) * 2)` (96px).
- Bar height (top bar and tab bar): `calc(var(--space-12) + var(--space-2))` (56px).
- Popover width: `calc(var(--space-12) * 6)` (288px).
- Decision column: `calc(var(--space-12) * 12)` (576px).
- 44px and 40px are the touch-target and row heights the design system fixes. They may be written as literals, as `.wl-menu__item` already does.

| Rule | Spec |
|---|---|
| `.wl-shell` | `display: grid; min-height: 100vh`. From 992px: `grid-template-columns: <sidebar width> minmax(0, 1fr)`. From 768 to 991px: `grid-template-columns: <rail width> minmax(0, 1fr)`. Under 768px: one column. |
| `.wl-sidebar` | `position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-6); background: var(--surface-sunken); border-right: 1px solid var(--line)`. Padding `var(--space-6) var(--space-4)` from 992px, `var(--space-4) var(--space-2)` in the rail. Under 768px: `display: none`. |
| `.wl-sidebar__account` | `margin-top: auto; padding-top: var(--space-4); border-top: 1px solid var(--line)`. |
| `.wl-brand` | The wordmark link. `display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap`. Markup adds `heading-2`. In the rail: `align-self: center`. |
| `.wl-topbar` | Under 768px only (`display: none` from 768px). `position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); min-height: <bar height>; padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4); background: var(--surface-sunken); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line)`. Not sticky: it scrolls away, so content gets the height on a phone. |
| `.wl-nav` | `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-1)`. |
| `.wl-nav__item` | `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); min-height: 44px; padding: 0 var(--space-3); border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--ink-muted); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out`. Markup adds `body`. Hover: `color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-raised)`. Icon `svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none }`. |
| `.wl-nav__item[aria-current="page"]` | `color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; background: var(--pitch-soft); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--pitch)`. Three cues (bar, weight, fill), so the state never rests on colour alone. |
| `.wl-nav__item` in the rail | `flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-1); min-height: calc(var(--space-12) + var(--space-2)); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-1); text-align: center`. Labels wrap onto 2 lines ("Review queue"), never truncate. For the label size, see the note under this table. |
| `.wl-tabbar` | Under 768px only. `position: fixed; inset: auto 0 0 0; z-index: 10; display: flex; background: var(--surface-raised); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`. |
| `.wl-tabbar__item` | `flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-1); min-height: <bar height>; padding: var(--space-1); color: var(--ink-muted); text-decoration: none; background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer`. Markup adds `caption` to the label. Icon 20px. |
| `.wl-tabbar__item[aria-current="page"]` | `color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 var(--pitch)`. The `More` button uses the same rule when it carries `aria-current="true"`. |
| `.wl-main` | `min-width: 0; padding-bottom` under 768px: `calc(<bar height> + var(--space-6) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))`, so the tab bar never covers the last line. The inner wrapper keeps `mx-auto max-w-7xl`. |
| `.wl-popover` | `position: absolute; z-index: 20; min-width: <popover width>; max-width: calc(100vw - var(--space-8)); max-height: 70vh; overflow-y: auto; padding: var(--space-1); background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop)`. Placement modifiers: `--below` (`top: calc(100% + var(--space-1)); left: 0`), `--below-end` (`top: calc(100% + var(--space-1)); right: 0`), `--beside` (`left: calc(100% + var(--space-2)); top: 0`, rail), `--above-end` (`bottom: calc(100% + var(--space-1)); right: var(--space-2)`, tab bar More), `--sheet` (top bar: `top: 100%; left: var(--space-4); right: var(--space-4); min-width: 0`). |
| `.wl-popover__heading` | `padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3) var(--space-1); color: var(--ink-muted)`. Markup adds `label`. |
| `.wl-popover__item` | Reuse the `.wl-menu__item` values, plus `min-height: 44px; height: auto; padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3); text-align: left`, so two-line rows (name plus caption) fit. Disabled: `opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed`. |
| `.wl-popover__footer` | `margin-top: var(--space-1); padding-top: var(--space-1); border-top: 1px solid var(--line)`. |
| `.wl-switcher` | The trigger in the full sidebar. `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); width: 100%; min-height: calc(var(--space-12) + var(--space-2)); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3); background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); text-align: left; cursor: pointer`. The `line-strong` border marks it as a control (3:1). Hover: `background: var(--surface)`. In the top bar: `flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-2)`. |
| `.wl-switcher--static` | Single organisation: same box with `border-color: transparent; background: transparent; cursor: default`. It is a `div`, not a button. |
| `.wl-avatar` in the rail switcher | Reuse `.wl-avatar` (44px, `pitch-soft`, `radius-pill`, `pitch` initials) inside a 44px `button` with `border-radius: var(--radius-pill)`, centred. |
| `.wl-skip` | The skip link. `position: absolute; left: var(--space-2); top: var(--space-2); z-index: 30` when focused; `sr-only` otherwise. Markup adds `wl-btn wl-btn--secondary`. |
| `.wl-skeleton` | `display: block; background: var(--surface-sunken); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); animation: wl-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite`. `@keyframes wl-pulse { 50% { opacity: .55 } }`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: `animation: none`. Heights: `--title` `calc(var(--space-8) + var(--space-1))` (the `heading-1` line), `--line` `var(--space-4)`, `--row` `40px`, `--hero` `calc(var(--space-12) * 4)`, `--video` `aspect-ratio: 16 / 9`. Widths come from Tailwind `w-1/2`, `w-2/3`, `w-full`. |
| `.wl-hero` | `background: var(--surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: var(--space-6)`. From 768px `padding: var(--space-8)`. From 1280px `padding: var(--space-12)`. |
| `.wl-workspace` | `display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-6)`. From 1280px: `grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr))`, primary pane `grid-column: span 8`, side pane `grid-column: span 4`. |
| `.wl-workspace__toolbar` | `position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); padding: var(--space-3) 0; background: var(--surface); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line)`. |
| `.wl-decision` | `max-width: <decision column>; margin-inline: auto`. |
| `.wl-decision__choice` | `position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); min-height: calc(var(--space-12) + var(--space-2)); padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4); background: var(--surface-raised); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out`. Markup adds `body-lg`. The radio: `accent-color: var(--pitch); width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; flex: none`. The trailing `Check` icon: `margin-left: auto; color: var(--pitch); visibility: hidden`. |
| `.wl-decision__choice:has(input:checked)` | `border-color: var(--pitch); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--pitch); background: var(--pitch-soft)`, and its `Check` icon `visibility: visible`. The 2px pitch edge, the fill, the filled radio and the icon carry the state together. |
| `.wl-decision__choice:has(input:focus-visible)` | `outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px`. The input itself keeps `outline: none` (PlayerCard pattern). |
| `.wl-empty` | `display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; gap: var(--space-3); padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-4); max-width: 65ch; margin-inline: auto`. |
| `.wl-empty__art` | `width: calc(var(--space-12) * 4); height: auto; margin-bottom: var(--space-3)`. Inner `.turf { fill: var(--turf) }`, `.chalk { fill: none; stroke: var(--chalk); stroke-width: 1.5 }`. Scoped under `.wl-empty__art` so it does not clash with `.wl-pitch`. |
| `.wl-table` (moved) | Move the rules from `globals.css` unchanged apart from type: drop both `font:` declarations. The header cell gets `label` and the numeric cell `data` in DataTable markup. Keep `position: sticky; top: 0` on `th`. Add `@media (pointer: coarse) { .wl-table td { height: 48px } }`. Delete the block from `globals.css`. |
| `.wl-table-wrap` | DataTable's region. `overflow: auto`. From 768px: `max-height: 70vh`, so the sticky header sticks inside the region on long tables. |
| Visibility helpers | `.wl-only-sidebar` (shown from 992px), `.wl-only-rail` (shown from 768 to 991px), `.wl-only-phone` (shown under 768px). Each sets `display: none` outside its range and nothing inside it. |

**Nav label size.** The sidebar label is `body` and the rail label is `caption`. The Additions font guard forbids font sizes in CSS, so each side-nav item renders two label spans: `<span class="body wl-only-sidebar">Dashboard</span><span class="caption wl-only-rail">Dashboard</span>`. The hidden span is `display: none`, so the accessible name is read once ("Dashboard").

## Surface 1: app shell, `(app)/layout.tsx`

**Who, where, job.** Every signed-in user, on every device: club admins and coaches on a laptop, scouts on a phone at the sideline, Wideline staff on a desktop. One job: show where you are, which organisation you are in, and get you to the next page.

**Access.** `requireUser()`. The shell is a convenience. Every page still calls `requirePageRole()` (AUTH06).

### Structure (DOM order = visual order = tab order)

`<div class="wl-shell">`:

1. Skip link `<a class="wl-skip wl-btn wl-btn--secondary" href="#main">` **Skip to content**.
2. `<aside class="wl-sidebar" aria-label="Sidebar">` (from 768px):
   1. Wordmark: `<Link href="/" class="wl-brand heading-2">` **Wideline**. Shown in the full sidebar and in the rail.
   2. Org switcher (Surface 3). Full trigger in `.wl-only-sidebar`, avatar trigger in `.wl-only-rail`.
   3. `<nav aria-label="Main">` with NavLinks `variant="side"` (Surface 2).
   4. `<div class="wl-sidebar__account">`: AccountMenu inline in `.wl-only-sidebar`, AccountMenu popover variant in `.wl-only-rail` (Surface 4).
3. `<header class="wl-topbar">` (under 768px): wordmark, org switcher (top-bar trigger), AccountMenu (popover variant).
4. `<main id="main" tabIndex={-1} class="wl-main px-4 md:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 md:py-8 outline-none">` holding `<div class="mx-auto max-w-7xl">{children}</div>`. `outline-none` applies to `main` only, which receives focus from the skip link and never from Tab.
5. `<nav aria-label="Main" class="wl-tabbar">` (under 768px) with NavLinks `variant="tabbar"`.

Only one "Main" nav is ever displayed: the sidebar nav is `display: none` under 768px and the tab bar is `display: none` from 768px.

### Layout

| | 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chrome | Top bar (56px, `surface-sunken`, `line` bottom border): wordmark left, switcher filling the middle, Account icon button right. Fixed tab bar at the bottom (`surface-raised`, `line` top border). | 96px rail on `surface-sunken`, full height, sticky: wordmark, avatar switcher, nav items with icon above a caption label, Account icon button at the bottom. | 240px sidebar on `surface-sunken`: wordmark, full switcher, nav items with icon left of a body label, account block (name, email, Sign out) at the bottom. |
| Content | One column, gutter `space-4`, bottom padding clears the tab bar. | Gutter `space-6`. | Gutter `space-8`, content capped at `max-w-7xl`. |

At 992 to 1023px the sidebar shows while Tailwind `lg` gutters are not yet on; the gutter stays `space-6` there. That is correct.

### States

| State | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| No active organisation | No switcher, no nav, no tab bar. The sidebar holds the wordmark and the account block only; the top bar holds the wordmark and the Account button. The page (`/organisations`) carries the C01 empty copy. |
| Role with no nav items (agent, player, guardian in v0) | Switcher and account as usual. The sidebar `nav` element is still rendered, empty (no heading, no copy). No tab bar on phones, and no tab-bar bottom padding on `main`. |
| Loading a page | The shell stays; only the content swaps to a skeleton (`(app)/loading.tsx`, Surface 6). |
| Page error | The shell stays; the content shows ErrorState (`(app)/error.tsx`). |
| Forbidden | `/forbidden` renders inside the shell with nav, so the user can move on (Surface 6). |
| Long organisation name | Truncated in the trigger with `title` set to the full name; wraps in the popover. |
| Long user name or email | Truncated (`truncate`) with `title` in the sidebar account block; wraps in the account popover. |
| Signed out | The proxy sends any shell URL to `/login?next=<path>`. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Tab order at 1280 and 768: skip link, wordmark, switcher trigger, each nav link in order, account controls (Sign out at 1280; Account button at 768), then page content.
- Tab order at 375: skip link, wordmark, switcher trigger, Account button, page content, then the tab bar links. The tab bar comes last because it sits last visually.
- The skip link moves focus to `main` (`tabIndex={-1}`).
- Landmarks: `aside` "Sidebar", `nav` "Main", `header` (phones), `main`. No other landmark per page, apart from what a page adds.

## Surface 2: main nav, `NavLinks.tsx` and `lib/nav.ts`

**Who, where, job.** Every user with a role in the active organisation, on every device. One job: move between the top-level areas their role can use.

### Items (fixed order)

| id | Label | href | Current when path is or starts with | Icon | Roles |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| dashboard | Dashboard | `/dashboard` | `/dashboard` | LayoutDashboard | owner, admin, coach |
| squad | Squad | `/squad` | `/squad` | Users | owner, admin, coach |
| matches | Matches | `/matches` | `/matches` | Video | owner, admin, coach |
| settings | Settings | `/settings/organisation` | `/settings` | Settings | owner, admin |
| review | Review queue | `/review` | `/review` | ListChecks | scout |
| shortlists | Shortlists | `/shortlists` | `/shortlists` | Bookmark | scout |
| admin | Admin | `/admin/organisations` | `/admin` | Wrench | platform_admin |
| lab | Lab | `/lab/matches` | `/lab` | FlaskConical | platform_admin |

Several roles give the deduplicated union in this order. "Current" is an exact match or a prefix match followed by `/` (so `/labx` is not Lab). `/organisations`, `/forbidden` and `/dev/*` have no nav item, so no item is current there.

### Variants

- **side** (sidebar and rail, one element): `ul role="list" class="wl-nav"`, one `li` per item, each a `Link class="wl-nav__item"` holding the icon and the two label spans (see the CSS note). Full sidebar: icon left of a `body` label. Rail: icon above a `caption` label, centred, wrapping to 2 lines when needed.
- **tabbar**: up to 5 items as `Link class="wl-tabbar__item"`, icon above a `caption` label. With 6 or more items, show the first 4 and a fifth slot: `<button class="wl-tabbar__item">` with `Ellipsis` and the label **More**. It opens a `.wl-popover--above-end` with heading **More pages** and the remaining items as `.wl-popover__item` links (icon plus `body` label). In v0 only an owner who is also a scout reaches 6 items.

### States

- Current item: `aria-current="page"`, `pitch-soft` fill, 2px `pitch` bar (left in the sidebar and rail, top in the tab bar), semibold label.
- Current item hidden under More: the More button gets `aria-current="true"` and the same current style; inside the popover the item carries `aria-current="page"`.
- Many items: the sidebar scrolls (`overflow-y: auto`); the tab bar never scrolls.

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Plain links in a list: Tab moves through them; Enter follows. No roving tabindex, no arrow keys.
- The accessible name of each link is its visible label. Icons are `aria-hidden`.
- More: a disclosure button (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`). See the popover rules in Surface 3.

## Surface 3: org switcher, `OrgSwitcher.tsx`

**Who, where, job.** Anyone in more than one organisation: a coach who also scouts for another club, Wideline staff with the demo club. Phone or desktop. One job: see which organisation is active, and switch to another in one step (AUTH05).

**Data.** `ctx.organisations` (sorted by name) and `ctx.organisationId`. A switch posts `organisationId` to the existing `switchOrganisation` action through `useActionState`; success redirects to `/`, which sends the user to `homeFor(roles)`.

### Trigger

| Organisations | Full sidebar | Rail | Phone top bar |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `div.wl-switcher.wl-switcher--static`: `eyebrow text-ink-muted` **Organisation**, then the name in `body-strong truncate` with `title`, then `caption text-ink-muted` with the type label ("Club"). No button. | `span.wl-avatar` with the initials (`aria-hidden`), plus an `sr-only` "Organisation: {name}". No button. | Name in `body-strong truncate` with `title`, no eyebrow. No button. |
| 2 or more | `button.wl-switcher` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`: eyebrow **Organisation**, name in `body-strong truncate` (with `title`), and a trailing `ChevronsUpDown` icon. | 44px `button` holding `span.wl-avatar` with the initials. | `button.wl-switcher` (compact): name in `body-strong truncate`, then `ChevronsUpDown`. |

- Initials: first letter of the first two words, upper case ("Wideline Demo FC" gives "WD"). A one-word name gives its first two letters ("Hellenic" gives "HE").
- Accessible name of every button trigger: `aria-label="Organisation: {name}. Switch organisation"`. It starts with the visible words, so voice control ("click Organisation") works.

### Popover (2 or more organisations)

Placement: `--below` in the sidebar, `--beside` in the rail, `--sheet` in the top bar. Contents, in order:

1. `p.wl-popover__heading label` **Switch organisation**.
2. On a refused switch, `div.wl-banner.wl-banner--danger role="alert"` with `CircleAlert` and **You can no longer switch to that organisation.** (C01 copy).
3. `ul role="list"`, one `li` per organisation:
   - Current: `li aria-current="true"`, a non-interactive row in `.wl-popover__item` layout with the name (`body-strong`), the meta line (`caption text-ink-muted`: "{type label} · {roles}", for example "Club · Owner, Coach"), and at the end a `Check` icon in `pitch` and the word **Current** in `label text-pitch`.
   - Others: `<form action={action}>` with a hidden `organisationId` and `<button type="submit" class="wl-popover__item">` holding `sr-only` "Switch to ", the name (`body-strong`) and the meta line. Accessible name: "Switch to {name} {type} · {roles}".
4. `div.wl-popover__footer` with `Link class="wl-popover__item body"` **Your organisations** to `/organisations`.

### States

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| One organisation | Static trigger, no popover. "Your organisations" is reachable from the account block. |
| Pending | The clicked row's meta line reads **Switching…**; every row button is `disabled`; the `ul` gets `aria-busy="true"`. |
| Refused | Banner above the list (copy above); focus moves to the banner's container so it is read; the popover stays open. |
| Success | Full navigation to `/`, then the role home. The popover closes with the page. |
| Many organisations | The popover scrolls inside `max-height: 70vh`. |
| Long names | Wrap inside the popover rows; truncate (with `title`) in the trigger. |
| Suspended or removed organisation | It is not in `ctx.organisations`, so it is not listed. |

### Keyboard, focus and screen readers (shared `usePopover` hook)

- Disclosure pattern, not an ARIA menu: the items are forms and links.
- Enter or Space on the trigger toggles the popover. On open, focus moves to the first focusable element inside (the first Switch row; with none, the footer link).
- Tab and Shift+Tab move through the rows and the footer. When focus leaves the trigger-plus-popover wrapper, the popover closes (`focusout` with `relatedTarget` outside the wrapper).
- Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
- A pointer-down outside the wrapper closes it without moving focus.
- `aria-expanded` on the trigger reflects the state. The panel has `id` (from `useId`) and `aria-label="Your organisations"`.
- The same hook drives the tab bar More popover and the account popover.

## Surface 4: account block and menu, `AccountMenu.tsx`

**Who, where, job.** Every signed-in user. One job: see who is signed in, and sign out.

| Width | Form |
|---|---|
| 1280 (full sidebar) | Inline in `.wl-sidebar__account`: name in `body-strong truncate`, email in `caption text-ink-muted truncate` (both with `title`), then `Link` **Your organisations** (`body text-pitch underline`, 44px tall line), then the existing `SignOutButton` (ghost sm, 44px on phones by the existing rule). |
| 768 (rail) and 375 (top bar) | `IconButton` with `CircleUser` and `aria-label="Account"`. It opens a popover (`--beside` in the rail, anchored to the bottom: `top: auto; bottom: 0`; `--below-end` in the top bar) holding the same contents: heading `label` with the name, `caption` email, **Your organisations** as a `.wl-popover__item`, then `SignOutButton` full width in the footer. |

States: long name and email truncate inline and wrap in the popover. Sign out redirects to `/login`. Keyboard as in Surface 3.

## Surface 5: page templates, `components/templates/`

All are server components with typed props. Each is used by later chunks; the showcase (Surface 9) renders each one.

### PageHeader

**Job.** One header pattern for every page.

Props: `title`, `eyebrow?`, `intro?`, `actions?` (at most one primary), `back?: { href, label }`.

Structure: `header` with
1. Back link (when given): `Link class="wl-btn wl-btn--ghost wl-btn--sm -ml-3"` with `ArrowLeft` and the label (for example **Matches**), plus `sr-only` "Back to " before the label.
2. `p.eyebrow text-ink-muted` (when given).
3. `h1.heading-1 break-words`.
4. `p.body text-ink-muted mt-2 max-w-prose` intro (when given).
5. Actions in `wl-row`.

Layout: at 375, actions sit under the intro (`mt-4`). From 768, the header is `flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4` with the title block on the left and actions on the right.

### ListPage and DataTable

**Job.** A list of things (players, matches, applications) with filters on top.

ListPage props: `header: PageHeaderProps`, `toolbar?`, `isEmpty?`, `empty?`, `footer?`, `children`. Structure: PageHeader; toolbar in `div.wl-row.mt-6` (filters, a search form); content in `div.mt-6`; footer in `div.mt-4` (for later pagination: `caption text-ink-muted` "Showing 1–50 of 212", then Previous and Next as secondary sm buttons). With `isEmpty`, the `empty` node (an EmptyState) replaces the content and the footer; the toolbar stays only if the chunk passes it.

DataTable props: `caption` (required), `columns: { id, header, numeric? }[]`, `rows: { id, cells: ReactNode[] }[]`, `cards?: ReactNode`.

- Wrapper: `div.wl-card.p-0.wl-table-wrap` with `role="region"`, `aria-label={caption}` and `tabIndex={0}`. With `cards`, the wrapper gets `hidden md:block`.
- `table.wl-table` with `caption.sr-only` = `caption`. `th scope="col" class="label"` (plus `num` when numeric). Numeric `td` gets `data num`; text `td` stays `body`.
- Rows 40px, 48px on a coarse pointer. Text left-aligned, numbers right-aligned, `line` dividers, no zebra stripes, sticky header.
- `cards` (phones): `ul role="list" class="md:hidden flex flex-col gap-3"`, one `wl-card` per row, no `id` attributes inside (C01 rule).

States: empty (ListPage `empty`), loading (ListSkeleton), missing value in a cell shows an en dash "–" in `text-ink-muted` (Lab convention), long text wraps in cells; wide tables scroll inside the focusable region.

### DetailPage

**Job.** One thing in depth: a player profile (C13), a match (C06).

Props: `back?`, `eyebrow?`, `title`, `meta?`, `badges?`, `actions?`, `media?`, `sections: { id, title, content }[]`.

Structure: back link (as in PageHeader); `section.wl-hero` with `aria-labelledby` the title:
- `media` (an initials avatar or a mini pitch) left of the text from 768px, above it at 375.
- `p.eyebrow text-ink-muted`, then the `h1`: `heading-1` at 375, `display-xl` from 768. Type classes cannot switch by breakpoint, so the `h1` holds two spans, `<span class="heading-1 md:hidden">{title}</span><span class="display-xl hidden md:inline">{title}</span>`. The hidden span is `display: none`, so the heading is read once. `display-xl` stays one per page.
- `p.body text-ink-muted mt-2` meta (for example "Winger · U17 · Left foot · Orlando Pirates Academy").
- Badges in `wl-row mt-3` (ConsentBadge, StatusChip).
- Actions in `wl-row mt-6`, at most one primary.

Then each section: `section.mt-8` with `aria-labelledby`, `h2.heading-2`, content `mt-4`.

States: small sample is shown by the content (StatTile's small-sample flag, "based on 2 matches" in `caption`); a missing meta field is left out, never shown as "undefined" or an empty separator; long names wrap (`break-words`); loading uses DetailSkeleton.

### Workspace

**Job.** Two panes side by side for focused work (C11 review: video left, events right).

Props: `theme?: "dark"`, `toolbar?`, `primary: { title, content }`, `side: { title, content }`, `titleHidden?: boolean` (visually hides the pane headings, keeping them for screen readers).

Structure: optional `ThemeScope theme="dark" className="rounded-lg p-4 md:p-6"`; inside, `div.wl-workspace__toolbar` (when given), then `div.wl-workspace.mt-4` with two `section`s, each `aria-labelledby` its `h2.heading-2`.

| 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|
| Stacked: primary, then side. | Stacked. | 12-column grid, `space-6` gap: primary 8 columns, side 4 columns. |

The split starts at 1280, not 992: with the 240px sidebar, a 4-column pane at 992 is about 210px wide, too narrow for an event list. Below 1280 the side pane sits under the primary pane, as on a phone.

States: loading uses WorkspaceSkeleton; an empty side pane shows a compact EmptyState (no art) supplied by the chunk.

### DecisionFlow and DecisionChoice

**Job.** One decision per screen, for guardians on a phone (C05 consent).

DecisionFlow props: `step?` ("Step 1 of 2"), `question`, `explainer?`, `action` (form action), `submitLabel`, `secondary?: { href, label }`, `children` (choices). DecisionChoice props: `name`, `value`, `label`, `hint?`, `defaultChecked?`.

Structure: `div.wl-decision`, then a plain `<form action>` (works without JavaScript):
1. `p.caption text-ink-muted` step.
2. `h1.heading-1` question.
3. `p.body-lg text-ink-muted mt-3` explainer.
4. `fieldset.mt-6 flex flex-col gap-3` with `legend.sr-only` = the question, holding the choices. Each choice: `label.wl-decision__choice body-lg` with `input type="radio"` (required), the label text, an optional `caption text-ink-muted` hint on a second line, and a trailing `Check` icon.
5. `Button variant="primary" block type="submit"` with `submitLabel` (full width and 48px on phones, auto width from 768).
6. Secondary link (when given): `Link class="wl-btn wl-btn--ghost mt-2"`, full width on phones.

States: no choice made and submitted: the browser's `required` check stops it; server-side validation errors use the C01 banner (`wl-banner--danger role="alert"` above the submit button). Pending: the C01 `SubmitButton` pending label. Long labels wrap inside the card; the card grows.

Keyboard: Tab to the radio group, arrow keys move between choices (native), Space selects, Tab to submit. The ring draws around the whole card.

## Surface 6: shared states, `components/states/`

### EmptyState

**Job.** Say plainly that there is nothing here yet, and what makes something appear.

Props: `title`, `body?`, `action?`, `art?: boolean` (default true), `headingLevel?: 1 | 2` (default 2; level 1 uses `heading-1` and is for full-page states such as "Page not found").

Structure: `div.wl-empty`; art; heading (`heading-2` or `heading-1`); `p.body-lg text-ink-muted` body; action in `mt-3`.

Art: an inline SVG, `aria-hidden="true"` and `focusable="false"`, `class="wl-empty__art"`, `viewBox="0 0 160 104"`: a `turf` rect with `rx` from `radius-md` (set through CSS on `.turf`, as Cover does), and in `chalk` the outline, the halfway line, the centre circle and both penalty boxes. No footballs, no trophies.

### Skeleton

`Skeleton` (one block, `aria-hidden`) and three presets. Each preset wrapper: `div role="status" aria-busy="true"` with `span.sr-only` **Loading…**.

- `ListSkeleton`: title block (`--title`, `w-1/2`), intro line (`--line`, `w-2/3`, `mt-2`), then a `wl-card` with 6 `--row` blocks separated by `space-2`.
- `DetailSkeleton`: back-link line (`--line`, `w-1/4`), a `--hero` block with `radius-lg`, then 2 section blocks (`--title` `w-1/3` plus 3 `--line`).
- `WorkspaceSkeleton`: a `--video` block and a column of 6 `--row` blocks, laid out with `.wl-workspace`.

Reduced motion: blocks are static.

### ErrorState (client-safe)

Props: `reset`, `digest?`, `headingLevel?: 1 | 2` (default 1).

- Title: **Something went wrong**.
- Body (`body-lg text-ink-muted`): **We could not load this page. Try again, or come back in a few minutes.**
- When `digest` is given: `p.caption text-ink-muted` **Reference:** followed by the digest in `span.data`.
- Actions: `Button variant="primary"` **Try again** (calls `reset`), then `ButtonLink variant="secondary" href="/"` **Go to your home page**.
- On mount, focus moves to the heading (`tabIndex={-1}`), so screen readers hear it.
- No art.

### ForbiddenState

Props: `homeHref?`, `headingLevel?: 1 | 2` (default 1).

- Title: **No access**.
- Body (`body-lg text-ink-muted`): **Your account does not have access to this page. Ask a Wideline admin if you think you need it.** (C01 copy, verbatim.)
- Actions: when `homeHref` is given, `ButtonLink variant="primary"` **Go to your home page**; then `ButtonLink variant="secondary" href="/login"` **Sign in as someone else**.
- No art.

### Routes

| Route | Renders |
|---|---|
| `(app)/loading.tsx` | `ListSkeleton` in the shell. |
| `(app)/lab/loading.tsx` | `ListSkeleton` inside the Lab's dark scope, so the Lab never flashes light. |
| `(app)/error.tsx` (`"use client"`) | `ErrorState` with `reset` and `error.digest`; reports with `Sentry.captureException(error)` in an effect. |
| `(app)/not-found.tsx` | For `notFound()` thrown by shell pages: `EmptyState headingLevel={1}`, title **Page not found**, body **The page you asked for does not exist or has moved.**, action `ButtonLink variant="secondary" href="/"` **Go to Wideline**. |
| `app/not-found.tsx` | Unmatched URLs, outside the shell: `main#main` with the page gutters, the wordmark link at the top, then the same EmptyState. Metadata title **Page not found**. |
| `(app)/forbidden/page.tsx` | Moved from `app/forbidden`, same URL. `requireUser()`, then `ForbiddenState` with `homeHref={homeFor(ctx.roles)}` when an organisation is active. Metadata title stays **No access**. |

## Surface 7: Lab pages inside the shell

**Who, where, job.** Wideline staff on a desktop. One job: see matches and pipeline runs.

- `(app)/lab/layout.tsx`: `requirePageRole(LAB_ROLES)`, then `ThemeScope theme="dark" className="rounded-lg p-4 md:p-6"` around children. The Lab's own aside, sub-nav, `text-[24px]` wordmark and sign-out go.
- **Theme: forced dark** on the content area. The shell around it follows the system setting.
- `(app)/lab/matches/page.tsx`: ListPage with eyebrow **CV Lab**, title **Matches**, no intro.
  - DataTable, caption **Matches, newest first**. Columns: Match, Date, Status, Video (numeric), Latest job, Recall (numeric). Cells as today: "{home} v {away}" in `body-strong` with "v" in `text-ink-muted`, competition in `caption`; date in `data`; `MatchStatusChip`; "–" and "None yet" placeholders in `text-ink-muted`.
  - Phone cards: home v away (`body-strong`), competition (`caption`), date (`data`) and the status chip.
  - Empty: EmptyState, title **No matches yet**, body **Create one to upload footage and run the pipeline.**

| 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|
| Dark panel inside the light or dark shell, card list. | Dark panel, table in its scroll region. | Same as 768, wider. |

**Who, where, job.** These reserve the routes and nav targets for later chunks. Each calls `requirePageRole` first, then renders ListPage with an EmptyState. No actions: none of their actions exist yet.

| Route | Roles | Replaced by | Title | Intro | Empty title | Empty body |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/dashboard` | CLUB_ROLES | C14 | Dashboard | {organisation name} at a glance. | Nothing to show yet | Your squad, matches by status and consent gaps appear here once your club adds players and uploads matches. |
| `/squad` | CLUB_ROLES | C04 | Squad | Teams and players in {organisation name}. | No players yet | Squad lists arrive here once your club adds teams and players. |
| `/matches` | CLUB_ROLES | C06 | Matches | Matches your club has uploaded, by status. | No matches yet | Uploaded matches appear here. |
| `/review` | SCOUT_ROLES | C10 | Review queue | Matches to claim, soonest footage deletion first. | No matches waiting | New matches appear here as clubs upload them. |
| `/shortlists` | SCOUT_ROLES | C15 | Shortlists | Players you are following. | No shortlists yet | Shortlists you build from player profiles appear here. |
| `/settings` | ORG_ADMIN_ROLES | none | redirects to `/settings/organisation` | | | |
| `/admin` | PLATFORM_ROLES | none | redirects to `/admin/organisations` | | | |

The `/review` empty copy is the design system's own. Metadata titles equal the page titles.

Rows: Thabo Nkosi (Winger, U17, 14, 0.62); Sipho Dlamini (Centre-back, U17, 9, 0.00); Lebo Mokoena (Striker, U15, 2, 0.50, with a `caption` "based on 2 matches" and the small-sample flag); Siyabonga Mthembu-Van der Merwe (Midfielder, U17, 11, "–") for long content and a missing value. Phone cards for the same rows. |

Sections **Season 2026 · U17** (3 StatTiles, one with a small sample) and **Match log** (a DataTable, caption **Matches, newest first**). |
| `/workspace` | Workspace `theme="dark"`: toolbar with **Wideline Demo FC v Hellenic U17** (`body-strong`) and **12 Oct 2026** (`data`); primary **Match video** with a `surface-sunken` 16:9 well, `radius-md`, holding `caption text-ink-muted` **Video plays here**; side **Events** with the three D01 ReviewEventRow fixtures. |
